summary: The ability-on-cooldown pattern, wrapping CountdownTimer with progress events for a UI bar.
overview: Call TryUse when the button is pressed; it succeeds or tells you it is not ready. OnCooldownProgress is meant for a radial or fill bar, which is exactly what RadialProgressBar consumes.
useCases: A player ability with a cooldown and a UI indicator.
An enemy special attack that cannot spam.
Any rate-limited action where the player needs to see the wait.

params.tuning: Seconds. The progress event reports 0-1 over this, so the UI does not need to know the duration.

gotchas.title: TryUse returning false is the normal case
gotchas.body: It is how you know the ability is not ready. Treat a false as "play the denied sound", not as an error.
